items.title: Demas
items.charge: Forsaking Paul, having loved this present world

items.title: Demetrius and the silversmiths of Ephesus
items.charge: Raising an uproar over lost trade under the colour of zeal for Diana

items.title: Diotrephes
items.charge: Loving the preeminence; prating against the apostle with malicious words; casting the brethren out of the church

items.title: Felix the governor
items.charge: Trembling at the judgment to come, hoping for a bribe, and leaving a man he knew to be innocent bound

items.title: Hazael king of Syria
items.charge: Smothering his master with a wet cloth to take the throne, and doing to Israel the evil Elisha wept over

items.title: Herod Antipas and Herodias
items.charge: Taking his brother’s wife; beheading John for saying so

items.title: Herod the Great and the children of Bethlehem
items.charge: Slaying all the male children of Bethlehem from two years old and under

items.title: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah
items.charge: Smiting Gedaliah the governor with the sword at his own table, and all the Jews and Chaldeans with him at Mizpah; slaying seventy of the eighty men coming with offerings to the house of the Lord and casting them into the pit; carrying the residue captive toward the Ammonites

items.title: Jeroboam the son of Joash
items.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord forty-one years; departing not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat

items.title: Joel and Abiah, the sons of Samuel
items.charge: Turning aside after lucre, taking bribes, and perverting judgment in the seat of the judge

items.title: Menahem king of Israel
items.charge: Ripping up all the women with child in Tiphsah; buying Assyria with a thousand talents of silver exacted from Israel

items.title: Pontius Pilate
items.charge: Condemning a man he had three times pronounced innocent

items.title: Potiphar’s wife
items.charge: Soliciting her husband’s servant day by day, and bearing false witness against him when he fled

items.title: Ptolemy the son of Abubus
items.charge: Murdering Simon the high priest and two of his sons at a banquet in his own castle

items.title: Rachel and the stolen teraphim
items.charge: Stealing her father’s images, and hiding them under her while she sat upon them

items.title: Sanballat, Geshem, and Noadiah
items.charge: Laughing the work to scorn; conspiring to fight against Jerusalem; sending four times to draw Nehemiah to the plain of Ono to do him mischief; an open letter charging rebellion; hiring Shemaiah and the prophetess Noadiah to put him in fear

items.title: Simon the governor of the temple
items.charge: Betraying the temple treasury to the king out of a private quarrel; slandering Onias the high priest

items.title: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin
items.charge: Weakening the hands of the people of Judah and troubling them in building; hiring counsellors against them to frustrate their purpose; writing accusations against Jerusalem to the king, and making the work cease by force and power

items.title: The chief priests, and the watch at the sepulchre
items.charge: Paying the soldiers large money to report a lie about the resurrection

items.title: The false witnesses against Stephen
items.charge: Suborning witnesses and stirring up the council against a man they could not answer

items.title: The rich young ruler
items.charge: Going away sorrowful, because he had great possessions

items.title: Tryphon
items.charge: Taking Jonathan the high priest by treachery under a covenant of friendship; slaying him and the young king Antiochus

items.title: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah, and the four hundred prophets
items.charge: Horns of iron and a lying spirit: prophesying victory at Ramoth-gilead in the name of the Lord, and smiting Micaiah on the cheek
